issuer: the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT), Driver and Vehicle Services
note: PennDOT's payments and fees page (read 2026-10-30) gives the initial permit and four-year licence at $45.50 and an initial identification card at $43.50. Its junior-to-senior page says a junior licence becomes a regular licence on the 18th birthday, so a full licence is kept from 18 (a junior holder may apply to move up at 17, which isn't held). The ID card's term wasn't read, so it is null; no youngest age for it was read.

sources.title: PennDOT, Payments and Fees
sources.said: Initial Permit and Four-Year License: $45.50 ... Identification Card (initial): $43.50

sources.title: PennDOT, Move from a Junior to a Senior License
sources.said: Your Junior Driver's License will automatically update to a Regular Driver's License on your 18th birthday.
